title: Validate a demand forecast over time
prompt: You forecast weekly item demand four weeks ahead using lagged demand, promotions, and price. Design a backtest that reflects deployment, prevents leakage in rolling features, handles multiple items, and compares against seasonal naive baselines. State how forecast horizon affects folds and metrics.
expected_concepts: Construct features using information available at each cutoff
Keep forecast horizon and label windows separated
Evaluate per item and in aggregate with scale-aware metrics

rubric.criterion: Prevents leakage in lags and rolling features

hints: Every fold needs its own historical cutoff and future horizon.
A random row split allows future observations into training.
follow_ups: How would intermittent demand affect metric choice?
What changes when promotion plans are revised after prediction time?

title: Represent short support messages
prompt: Design a baseline classifier for short support messages with 20 labeled categories, class imbalance, misspellings, and unseen words. Compare word and character TF-IDF with dense embeddings, choose an initial model and metrics, and explain how the vectorizer avoids validation leakage.
expected_concepts: Word and character features have different robustness tradeoffs
Sparse linear models provide strong text baselines
Fit vocabulary and weighting only on training data
Unknown tokens and misspellings affect representations differently
hints: Character n-grams can share information across misspellings.
The vocabulary and inverse document frequencies are learned parameters.
follow_ups: When might a pretrained encoder justify its cost?
How would you inspect category-specific failure modes?

title: Validation loss rises during neural training
prompt: A neural classifier's training loss falls steadily, validation loss rises after epoch 8, and validation accuracy remains nearly flat. Diagnose likely causes, define checks that distinguish overfitting from a train-validation pipeline mismatch, and propose a prioritized correction plan without using the test set.
expected_concepts: The curves are consistent with overfitting but not conclusive alone
Verify preprocessing, label mapping, augmentation, and evaluation mode
Use early stopping and retain the best validation checkpoint
Regularization, capacity, and data changes have distinct tradeoffs
The test set remains untouched during diagnosis

rubric.criterion: Uses early stopping and checkpoint selection correctly
Prioritizes justified regularization or data changes

hints: First confirm that training and validation examples receive compatible transformations.
Save the parameters from the best validation epoch, not the final epoch.
follow_ups: How would dropout behavior differ between training and evaluation?
What evidence would suggest label-distribution shift instead?
